tasks.label: stop-aspire
args: set -euo pipefail; pids=$(ps -eo pid,args | awk '/\/workspaces\/AspireStarterApp\/.+\/bin\/Debug\/net10\.0\/(AspireStaterDemo\.AppHost|AspireStaterDemo\.ApiService|AspireStarterDemo\.Angular|AspireStaterDemo\.Web)( |$)/ {print $1}' | sort -u | xargs); if [[ -n "${pids:-}" ]]; then kill $pids || true; sleep 1; kill -9 $pids || true; fi; for p in 17277 15083 21275 22182 7026 5116 7088 5297 7528 5413; do lsof -ti tcp:$p | xargs -r kill -9 || true; done
